_comment: Phone calls. 'requests' are what callers ask for (add as many as you like). 'brushOffs' are what Andy says when he brushes someone off; 'ticketLines' when he logs a ticket.
requests: Can you connect my gym equipment to the internet?
I need a full Office license.
I poured coffee in my laptop.
How do I make my CCTV work?
I need AI to do my job for me.
My eyes hurt from the new wallpaper.
My mouse is on the wrong side of the desk.
Can you print the internet for me?
The cloud is full. Can you empty it?
My password expired. Can I have the old one back?
Can you make Teams less... Teams?
My screen has gone dark. Oh wait, it's lunchtime.
The printer is printing in the wrong colour.
Can you fix my phone? It's my personal one.
I clicked the link. The one that said DON'T CLICK.
My keyboard has stopped typing the letter E.
Can I have admin rights? Just for today.
The Wi-Fi is slow in the car park.
I deleted the shared drive. Is that bad?
Can you put my holiday photos on the big screen?
brushOffs: A problem, but not my problem.
Have you tried turning it off and leaving?
Not my circus, not my clowns.
Put it in writing. In crayon.
ticketLines: Ticket logged. Priority: low. Very low.
Fine. I'll take a look. Eventually.
